definitionZh: * 目标文本 CSS 伪元素代表浏览器支持文本片段时滚动到的文本. 它允许作者选择如何突出该部分文本.
sourceDefinition: The ::target-text CSS pseudo-element represents the text that has been scrolled to if the browser supports text fragments. It allows authors to choose how to highlight that section of text.
